title: Selfie de Espejo en Rave Nocturno de Tokyo con Corsé de Vinilo
prompt: Sakura is frantically racing the clock—she's already 45 minutes late for the underground warehouse rave in Roppongi, Tokyo. Her friends are blowing up her phone, but she's struggling with the final touch: a reflective, high-tension vinyl corset. She snatches a quick, tense mirror selfie in the hallway to check if the zipper is going to hold, capturing the rush, the sweaty skin from the stress, and the sheer chaos of trying to achieve peak glamour under pressure. She's not smiling; she's intensely focused on the phone screen's preview.
